statement: For an exact finite signed-Q witness source over an ambient deformation base S and one marked reduced irreducible Hodge branch H, prove smoothness/integrability of W_alpha x_S H -> H at a useful point together with proper/component binding, or establish full actual branch image by a direct dominance/top-dimensional closed-image argument.
separate_open_coordinates: exact signed-Q witness source and transported class identity
higher-Artin/formal lifting where not subsumed by actual smoothness

local: branch-relative smoothness/integrability or direct local dominance

falsifier_for_future_reuse: A source-specific Hodge incidence whose base-changed map to H is still singular/nondominant despite the proposed repair blocks reuse.
